method: Held-out trigger eval. A judge sees ONLY the skill's frontmatter `description` (the real selection signal) plus the prompt, and predicts whether the `design` skill should fire. Predictions are scored against the `expected` gold labels below → precision/recall. The scope is now build + refine + enhance + fix + evaluate (not review-only), so UI-generation prompts (n3, n8) are positives. LLM-judged, so results.json is a snapshot (re-runs may vary slightly).
